name: Run Defender Quick Scan
description: Runs a quick Microsoft Defender scan to check common areas for malware without scanning the entire system.

description_i18n.en: Runs a quick Microsoft Defender scan to check common areas for malware without scanning the entire system.
description_i18n.de: Führt einen schnellen Microsoft-Defender-Scan aus, um häufige Bereiche auf Malware zu prüfen, ohne das gesamte System zu scannen.
description_i18n.fr: Lance une analyse rapide avec Microsoft Defender pour vérifier les zones courantes de logiciels malveillants sans scanner tout le système.

warnings.title: Security setting change
warnings.message: Windows security, Defender, Firewall, or SmartScreen behavior may change immediately

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the Start-MpScan cmdlet with the QuickScan type to perform a targeted security check on standard system areas
